experiment_id_status: Await frozen plan; no invented ID.
stage: Before any new generated outputs inspected
priority: Felt impact/movement and compelling power/composition, with quiet ground central. Mechanics is necessary evidence, not an appeal proxy.

criteria.check: Lead with the visible body event: acceleration, compression, recoil, loss of balance, redirected weight, interrupted action or a costly landing. Trace source→contact/near-miss→target consequence. Distinguish preparation, sustained pressure and aftermath from an instantaneous blow. A correct grip, touching endpoint or glow alone is insufficient.

Assess a purposeful action silhouette, line of force, depth/overlap, camera placement and large shape contrast. A power should change a specific physical relationship in an interesting recognizable way, not merely add a generic beam or aura. Extreme camera or exaggerated pose must still make source and target understandable.

Judge the floor/water as a major value-and-shape field, not just microtexture. Repeated bright reflections, tile seams, puddle bands, sparkles and debris must not compete with faces/contact/trajectory. Broad high-contrast shiny bands can remain noisy. Preserve necessary footing, material and depth; do not reward blank, flat or plastic ground.

Effects should show direction, speed, pressure, impact or material change with a few clear shapes. A quiet area should let the event read. Do not accept an effect veil over unchanged target posture, or remove force-bearing spray/trails merely to reduce density.

Judge expressive adult faces and character charisma separately from mechanical compliance. Verify loaded limbs, believable joints, relevant hands/weapon continuity and no accidental extra people. Minor distortion matters in proportion to its effect on action/identity; stylized foreshortening is not automatically an error. Giant size requires architectural/human anchors and credible mass response.

Inspect every actual native attempt before root preferred verdict, then actual390px phone rendering. Compare paired core/radical art at equal art width and equivalent framing display; record source IDs/SHA and stage. Report what is visible, uncertain or absent; do not infer motion, comfort or acceptance from captions, labels, metadata or image statistics.

Evaluate core and radical variants on the same impact, ground, acting and comprehension questions. Radical difference alone is neither a win nor a failure. If composition, character, effect and treatment all change, describe the combined result without claiming a causal isolation. Keep concrete gains and regressions; source-only F must not be credited with structural fixes.

pre_image_watchlist: Static action poster with correct grips but unchanged target torso/center of mass.
Bright floor/reflection pattern dominating the panel after nominal texture reduction.
Repeated generic cyan/white beam or ring substituting for distinctive power behavior.
Overcrowded cast/FX making a contact look dramatic but untraceable.
Radical camera judged more generously because it is new, or penalized solely for departing from the baseline.
Source-only finish weakening the very spray, trail or deformation that carried movement, as in prior D05.

preflight_references.label: CD D08-F1
observations: Clear descending near-miss and duck silhouettes, but the large bright repeated floor reflections compete with movement. Clear pose does not itself establish violent momentum.

preflight_references.label: CD G04-F1
observations: Blade-water-ice-boot chain is legible; the bulky target feels low and posed more than violently losing balance. Mechanic comprehension and felt consequence must be judged separately.

preflight_references.label: CD W03-F1
observations: Pulse ring and raised paw are visible, but high massive shoulder limits the sense of weight collapsing. Effect contact is not proof of bodily consequence.

preflight_references.label: CD W06-F1
observations: Impressive territory and road loss; broad yet repeated light bands still occupy much water/ground. Quiet aftermath is not an impact benchmark.

preflight_references.label: Original Nightglass
observations: Bold white-coat/dark-creature contrast, asymmetric creature silhouette and deep city provide appeal. Static design-board glamour cannot be treated as evidence of exciting action.

preflight_references.label: Approved finish
observations: Large calm wall planes and selective face/armor detail demonstrate focus. Weapon crossing and good drawing do not independently prove movement or impact.

authorized_budget.F_condition: Observed surface competition only; do not finish already calm art.
